title: Chips JU: Testing and validation of new semiconductor technology in pilot lines
audience: Swedish small and medium-sized companies working in design, development of production processes and products, production, research and innovation in semiconductor technology. The company must have received approval to access to the pilot line
requirements: Swedish small and medium-sized companies working in design, development of production processes and products, production, research and innovation in semiconductor technology. The company must have received approval to access to the pilot line

Maximum 3.5 million per project.
The total budget for the call in 2026 and 2027 is 7 million SEK per year.
summary: You can apply for funding for the use of a pilot line within Chips JU for the development of, for example, new processes, design, material structure and components in semiconductor technology.

title: Innovative Startups 2026
audience: Swedish limited liability companies that are no more than 10 years old, have a maximum of 10 employees, a maximum of SEK 10 million in net sales or balance sheet total and no profit distribution.
requirements: Swedish limited liability companies that are no more than 10 years old, have a maximum of 10 employees, a maximum of SEK 10 million in net sales or balance sheet total and no profit distribution.
Maximum SEK 500,000.
summary: Funding of activities to ensure that an innovative idea has a market, as well as to test and confirm its potential.

title: Chips JU Calls 2026: European collaborative project in electronic components and systems (ECS)
audience: Swedish companies that meet Vinnova´s eligibility requirements as well as universities, university colleges and research institutes.
requirements: Swedish companies that meet Vinnova´s eligibility requirements as well as universities, university colleges and research institutes.

Maximum funding from Vinnova to an individual large company, university, university college and research institute is equivalent to €750,000.
Maximum funding from Vinnova to small and medium-sized enterprises is equivalent to €450,000.
summary: Participation in European collaborative projects focusing on electronic components and systems (ECS).

title: Eureka SMART Call 10 - International collaborative projects within Advanced Manufacturing 2027
audience: Consortia of business, industry and academia from at least two of the countries participating in Eureka. At least one Swedish company must participate. Proposal is submitted to SMART.
requirements: Consortia of business, industry and academia from at least two of the countries participating in Eureka. At least one Swedish company must participate. Proposal is submitted to SMART.
We fund up to 5 million per project, and a maximum of 50 percent of the project´s eligible costs. Projects generally run over three years.
summary: Research or development projects in advanced manufacturing. The aim is to achieve a competitive and resilient manufacturing industry with net zero greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Eureka Innowwide call 5
audience: Small and medium-sized companies looking to explore new international markets in Asia, Africa, Oceania and the Americas with a local partner, such as a supplier, research actor or technology developer. See exact limitations and criteria at Eureka.
requirements: Small and medium-sized companies looking to explore new international markets in Asia, Africa, Oceania and the Americas with a local partner, such as a supplier, research actor or technology developer. See exact limitations and criteria at Eureka.
Up to EUR 60,000. Co-financing of at least EUR 26,000 is required
summary: Development and testing of a product or service for international markets

title: Preparatory projects for the EU co-funded Raw Materials Partnership (RAMP)
audience: Nordic consortia consisting of partners from at least three different Nordic countries. Nordic countries are defined here as Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden, Faroe Islands, Greenland, and Åland Islands. The project coordinator needs to be a research performing organisation from a Nordic country (see details on the NordForsk call webpage).
requirements: Nordic consortia consisting of partners from at least three different Nordic countries. Nordic countries are defined here as Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden, Faroe Islands, Greenland, and Åland Islands. The project coordinator needs to be a research performing organisation from a Nordic country (see details on the NordForsk call webpage).

The maximum funding per project is NOK 1 000 000. Project owners, who will be funded by NordForsk, can apply for no more than NOK 400 000. Partners from SWE/NO/FI can apply for no more than NOK 300 000 from their respective national funding agency (Vinnova, The Research Council of Norway and Business Finland).
summary: Preparatory projects aimed at building or strengthening Nordic consortia and developing competitive proposals for submission to calls by RAMP or other calls under Horizon Europe and complementary programs.

title: Expression of interest 2026 for national co-financing of ongoing and upcoming project in the EU program DIGITAL

title: Cybersecurity, AI and resilience
audience: Consortia with at least two participants, of which at least one company is from Swedish industry. Universities, university colleges, research institutes and other relevant organisations may also participate in the consortium.
requirements: Consortia with at least two participants, of which at least one company is from Swedish industry. Universities, university colleges, research institutes and other relevant organisations may also participate in the consortium.
It is possible to apply for 1-10 MSEK in funding per project. The grant may correspond to a maximum of 50 percent of the project´s eligible costs. The projects must last between 12 and 24 months.
summary: Research and innovation projects that develop innovative solutions for strengthened cybersecurity and digital resilience in industrial digital systems. The projects will be driven by industrial needs and challenges.

title: Efficient product development of cyber-physical systems, through advanced digitalization
audience: A consortium with at least two participants, of which at least two industrial project partners in the form of a company. In addition to companies, academia, institutes, public activities or authorities can participate.
requirements: A consortium with at least two participants, of which at least two industrial project partners in the form of a company. In addition to companies, academia, institutes, public activities or authorities can participate.

It is possible to apply for a maximum of 8 million kronor in funding per project. The grant may correspond to a maximum of 50 percent of the project´s eligible costs. The project duration must be between 12 and 24 months.
summary: Research and innovation projects that develop innovative solutions for efficient product development of cyber-physical systems. The projects should be driven by industrial needs and challenges.

title: Innovative solutions of the future in life science
audience: Collaborative constellations with at least three actors where companies and academia must be represented. Several relevant actors may be included.
requirements: Collaborative constellations with at least three actors where companies and academia must be represented. Several relevant actors may be included.
The project can be granted up to SEK 3 million over 12 months. Vinnova finances a maximum of 50 percent of the project´s total costs.
summary: To develop innovative technologies, products and processes in life science that meet the needs of the future.

title: Industrial flexible energy control with advanced digitalization
audience: The projects must have at least two participants, whereof at least one need owner from Swedish industry. Companies, universities, research institutes and other relevant organisations can be part of the consortium.
requirements: The projects must have at least two participants, whereof at least one need owner from Swedish industry. Companies, universities, research institutes and other relevant organisations can be part of the consortium.
Between 2 to 8 million SEK for a research and innovation project lasting 12 to 24 months. Vinnova´s funding may be a maximum of 50 percent of the project´s eligible costs.
summary: Research and innovation projects that use advanced digital technology to enable more efficient and flexible energy use in Swedish industrial companies. The projects will be driven by the needs of the industry.

title: 5G and automation for operational industrial benefit
audience: Consortia must include at least two parties, including one Swedish industrial company. Industry needs owners must participate. Universities, research institutes and other relevant organisations may also be part of the consortium.
requirements: Consortia must include at least two parties, including one Swedish industrial company. Industry needs owners must participate. Universities, research institutes and other relevant organisations may also be part of the consortium.
Projects may apply for grants of SEK 3-15 million. The grant may cover up to 50% of the project´s eligible costs. Project duration must be between 12 and 36 months.
summary: Project that develops, tests and verifies solutions with high eligibility requirements on connectivity and digital infrastructure. Based on industry needs and enabling value-creating applications where 5G standalone (5G SA) is an important component.

title: Driving urban transitions: sustainable urban transformation within European partnership
audience: Actors from academia, research institutes, public sector, business and civil society. The consortium should include three partners from three different countries in DUT including a municipality/local public authority and an actor from private sector.
requirements: Actors from academia, research institutes, public sector, business and civil society. The consortium should include three partners from three different countries in DUT including a municipality/local public authority and an actor from private sector.
Swedish parties can apply for a maximum of 300,000 euros per project.
summary: Research and innovation projects for sustainable urban transformation. Vinnova specifically funds project that is linked to the 15-minute city.

title: The Baltic Marine Watchdog Challenge
audience: Teams with ambition, technical expertise, and business drive. Only legal entities are eligible to apply. Individuals or sole proprietorships are welcome to participate in a team in which a legal entity sends in the submission.
requirements: Teams with ambition, technical expertise, and business drive. Only legal entities are eligible to apply. Individuals or sole proprietorships are welcome to participate in a team in which a legal entity sends in the submission.
Vinnova provides financing over two stages in the form of an individually fixed price based on each team’s cost estimates. Total maximum funding per team: €520,000. Total time period: 10 months.
summary: To develop, demonstrate, and validate fully autonomous systems for maritime surveillance, vessel tracking, documentation, and monitoring.

title: FORESTPathways: Building Knowledge and Solutions for Resilient Forests and Sustainable Forest-Based Futures
audience: Research providers, public organisations, companies (not sole proprietorships) and civil society organisations. Project teams must consist of at least three partners from three different countries participating in the call for proposals.
requirements: Research providers, public organisations, companies (not sole proprietorships) and civil society organisations. Project teams must consist of at least three partners from three different countries participating in the call for proposals.

Swedish actors in an international consortium can jointly apply for a maximum of 300,000 euros. If a Swedish actor coordinates the entire international consortium, Swedish actors can jointly apply for up to 400,000 euros in funding.
summary: Research and innovation projects that contribute knowledge and solutions for a sustainable forest sector.

title: European collaborations for sustainable food systems - FutureFoodS call 3
audience: Actors in civil society, companies, public sector and academia with a branch or operating location in Sweden. At least one Swedish actor who is not part of academia is required. Multiple Swedish partners require one coordinator for Swedish funding.
requirements: Actors in civil society, companies, public sector and academia with a branch or operating location in Sweden. At least one Swedish actor who is not part of academia is required. Multiple Swedish partners require one coordinator for Swedish funding.

Vinnova funds Swedish actors with up to 300,000 euros per project. If a Swedish actor acts as coordinator for the entire transnational consortium, the project can apply for up to 450,000 euros in funding for Swedish actors.
summary: Swedish participation in the FutureFoodS third call for proposals. The consortium shall consist of at least three project partners from at least three different participating countries. Vinnova only finances innovation oriented projects.
